name: Monitor scheduled workflow health with Silent Fail pings
description:
## Quick Overview
This workflow runs every hour and performs your custom work, then pings Silent Fail via an HTTP request so Silent Fail can alert you if the workflow stops running and the expected pings no longer arrive.

## How it works
1. Runs every hour on a schedule trigger.
2. Executes your custom workflow steps (replacing the placeholder step).
3. Sends an HTTP request to the Silent Fail ping URL to report a successful run completion.
4. Silent Fail monitors the ping cadence and alerts you if the workflow stops checking in.

## Setup
1. Create a monitor in Silent Fail and copy its ping URL/token.
2. Update the HTTP request URL to replace `PASTE_YOUR_MONITOR_TOKEN` with your Silent Fail monitor token.
3. Set the monitor’s expected interval in Silent Fail to match the workflow schedule (hourly by default), then activate the workflow.

workflow.name: Know when this workflow stops running

parameters.content:
## Know when this workflow stops running

### How it works

1. A schedule trigger starts this workflow every hour.
2. Your own steps run in place of the placeholder node.
3. The last node calls a Silent Fail ping URL to report that the run finished.
4. Silent Fail expects that call on a schedule, and emails you when it stops arriving.

This catches the one failure an error handler cannot. A workflow that stops running produces no error, so nothing tells you it stopped. A deactivated schedule, an expired credential, an instance that went down: all silent.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a monitor at [silentfailapp.com](https://silentfailapp.com) and copy its ping URL. No credentials are needed anywhere in this workflow.
- [ ] Open the "Ping Silent Fail" node and replace PASTE_YOUR_MONITOR_TOKEN in the URL with your own monitor token.
- [ ] Set the monitor's expected interval in Silent Fail to match this schedule, hourly by default.
- [ ] Replace the placeholder node with the work you want watched, then activate the workflow.

### Customization

Change the schedule to match how often your job should run. Move the ping to sit only on the branch you care about, and Silent Fail will report only that branch as alive. Widen the grace period in Silent Fail if your run duration varies a lot.

## Run the work, then check in

Runs on a schedule, does the work, and reports completion to Silent Fail as the last step.
